visualCharacteristics: A deep-blue section with a full-bleed key visual, a white heading and lead, a grid of sales-channel items with images, and a list of image-and-text service features.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: key visual [picture only]; head [h2][lead paragraphs]; channel rows (repeat) [group title h2, may be empty][picture][h6 + paragraphs]; service rows (repeat) [picture][h3 + paragraphs].
usage: Use it to describe a company's business, sales channels and service features on a recruitment page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for the same key-visual plus channel-grid structure; use cards or columns for generic feature lists.
